description: Golden set of 100 questions for RAG evaluation. Non-negative questions have a single correct answer derivable from the corpus. Negative questions are unanswerable from the corpus and the system should reject them. key_facts are literal (whitespace-insensitive) substrings of the corpus that a correct answer should reflect; expected_value is the canonical final value for exact/normalized matching.

questions.question: When was Nimbus Robotics founded?
questions.expected_answer: Nimbus Robotics was founded in 2019.

questions.question: Who are the founders of Nimbus Robotics?
questions.expected_answer: Nimbus Robotics was co-founded by Maya Chen and David Okafor.

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of Nimbus Robotics?
questions.expected_answer: Nimbus Robotics is headquartered in Austin, Texas, after moving there from Portland, Oregon in 2023.

questions.question: How many cities does the Nimbus fleet operate in as of Q1 2025?
questions.expected_answer: The Nimbus fleet operates in 43 cities as of Q1 2025.

questions.question: How many robots are in the deployed Nimbus fleet?
questions.expected_answer: The deployed Nimbus fleet consists of 12,400 robots.

questions.question: How many employees does Nimbus Robotics have?
questions.expected_answer: Nimbus Robotics has 850 employees as of Q1 2025.

questions.question: How much funding did Nimbus raise in its Series C round?
questions.expected_answer: Nimbus raised $240M in its Series C round.

questions.question: When did Nimbus close its Series C funding round?
questions.expected_answer: Nimbus closed its Series C in June 2024.

questions.question: Which firm led Nimbus's Series C funding round?
questions.expected_answer: Meridian Capital led the Series C round.

questions.question: What was Nimbus's post-money valuation after the Series C?
questions.expected_answer: Nimbus's post-money valuation after the Series C was $1.8B.

questions.question: When was the NB-1 Courier announced?

questions.question: When did the NB-1 Courier launch commercially?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 Courier launched commercially in September 2020.

questions.question: What is the maximum payload of the NB-1 Courier?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 Courier has a maximum payload of 25 kg.

questions.question: What is the top speed of the NB-1 Courier?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 Courier has a top speed of 24 km/h.

questions.question: What is the range of the NB-1 on a single charge?

questions.question: What are the voltage and capacity of the NB-1's battery?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1's battery is a 48 V lithium-ion pack with 10.2 kWh capacity.

questions.question: How long does a full standard charge take for the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: A full standard charge (0-100%) takes 2 h 15 min for the NB-1.

questions.question: How long does it take to charge the NB-1 from 0 to 80% on fast charge?
questions.expected_answer: Fast charging takes 45 minutes to reach 80% on the NB-1.

questions.question: How many RGB cameras are on the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 has 8 RGB cameras with 360-degree coverage.

questions.question: What is the ingress protection rating of the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 has an IP65 ingress protection rating.

questions.question: What is the operating temperature range of the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 operates between −10 °C and 45 °C.

questions.question: What is the unloaded weight of the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 weighs 85 kg unloaded.

questions.question: What is the mean time between failures for the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1's MTBF is 12,000 hours.

questions.question: What was the NB-1's fleet uptime in 2024?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1's fleet uptime in 2024 was 99.2%.

questions.question: When did the NB-2 Hauler launch commercially?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 Hauler launched commercially in April 2024.

questions.question: What is the maximum payload of the NB-2 Hauler?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 Hauler has a maximum payload of 60 kg.

questions.question: What is the range of the NB-2 on a single charge?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 has a range of 110 km on a single charge.

questions.question: What are the voltage and capacity of the NB-2's battery?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2's battery is a 72 V lithium-ion pack with 18.5 kWh capacity.

questions.question: What is the ingress protection rating of the NB-2?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 has an IP67 ingress protection rating.

questions.question: What is the operating temperature range of the NB-2?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 operates between −20 °C and 50 °C.

questions.question: What is the unloaded weight of the NB-2?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 weighs 142 kg unloaded.

questions.question: How long does a battery pack swap take on the NB-2?
questions.expected_answer: A battery pack swap on the NB-2 takes under 90 seconds.

questions.question: What was the NB-2's fleet uptime in 2024?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2's fleet uptime in 2024 was 99.4%.

questions.question: What is the average remote intervention rate for the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 averages 4.2 remote interventions per 1,000 km driven.

questions.question: What is the average remote intervention rate for the NB-2?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 averages 3.1 remote interventions per 1,000 km driven.

questions.question: What is the scheduled maintenance interval for the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 requires scheduled maintenance every 500 operating hours or 2,000 km, whichever comes first.

questions.question: What is the scheduled maintenance interval for the NB-2?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 requires scheduled maintenance every 800 operating hours.

questions.question: After how many charge cycles should the NB-1's battery be replaced?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1's battery should be replaced after 800 charge cycles, when capacity falls below 80% of rated.

questions.question: When are over-the-air updates deployed fleet-wide?
questions.expected_answer: OTA updates are deployed on Tuesdays between 02:00 and 04:00 local time.

questions.question: In what cohort size are OTA updates rolled out?
questions.expected_answer: OTA updates are rolled out in 25% cohorts.

questions.question: What is the default speed limit inside a geofenced zone?
questions.expected_answer: The default speed limit inside a geofence is 24 km/h.

questions.question: What is the daily dock and charging window for Nimbus robots?
questions.expected_answer: Robots dock and charge between 01:00 and 05:00 local time.

questions.question: How many deliveries does an NB-1 average per day?
questions.expected_answer: An NB-1 averages 38 deliveries per day.

questions.question: How many deliveries does an NB-2 average per day?
questions.expected_answer: An NB-2 averages 52 deliveries per day.

questions.question: What was the fleet-wide collision rate in 2024?
questions.expected_answer: The fleet-wide collision rate in 2024 was 0.03 per 10,000 km.

questions.question: How do I trigger the emergency stop on a Nimbus robot?
questions.expected_answer: Press the physical emergency stop button on the rear panel; it cuts drive power within 100 ms and latches until an operator resets it.
questions.expected_value: physical e-stop on rear panel; 100 ms

questions.question: Within what time frame must a Level 1 incident be reported?
questions.expected_answer: A Level 1 incident (no injury, no property damage) must be reported within 24 hours.

questions.question: What is the reporting deadline for a Level 2 incident?
questions.expected_answer: A Level 2 incident (minor injury) must be reported within 4 hours.

questions.question: What are the reporting requirements for a Level 3 incident?
questions.expected_answer: A Level 3 incident (serious injury or major property damage) must be reported within 1 hour and the regional manager must be notified.

questions.question: What training is required for a remote operator before working solo shifts?
questions.expected_answer: Remote operators must complete 16 hours of initial training before solo shifts, plus 8 hours of annual recertification every 12 months.

questions.question: What does a robot do when it crosses a geofence boundary?
questions.expected_answer: The robot halts with error E317 (geofence breach) and requires operator approval to resume.

questions.question: What happens when a robot hits error E402?
questions.expected_answer: E402 is an over-temperature condition (internal 55 °C); the robot pauses and resumes after 15 min of cooling.

questions.question: What happens when a Nimbus robot gets stuck?
questions.expected_answer: The robot attempts to free itself up to 3 times, then pages the NOC for remote assistance.

questions.question: What happens to in-progress deliveries if the customer app goes offline?
questions.expected_answer: Robots continue operating from cached routes, and deliveries already in progress complete normally.

questions.question: How is the NB-2's battery replaced?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 uses a swappable battery pack that can be swapped in under 90 seconds.

questions.question: What does a robot do when its battery drops below 5%?
questions.expected_answer: On error E204 (battery below 5%), the robot automatically returns to its dock to charge.

questions.question: How does heavy rain affect robot operation?
questions.expected_answer: Robots continue operating in rain (IP65/IP67), but in heavy rain their speed is reduced by 20%.

questions.question: Can the NB-1 operate in snow?
questions.expected_answer: No, the NB-1 is suspended in snow; only the NB-2 can operate in light snow (down to −20 °C with traction control).

questions.question: How should a technician resolve error E101 on a robot?
questions.expected_answer: E101 indicates a LiDAR obstruction; power down and clean the sensor array.
questions.expected_value: power down and clean sensor array

questions.question: What is the onsite service response time for a critical failure?
questions.expected_answer: Critical failures get a 4 business hour onsite response; non-critical issues get 24 hours.

questions.question: How much more payload can the NB-2 carry compared to the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 carries 35 kg more than the NB-1 (60 kg vs 25 kg).

questions.question: Which robot has the higher ingress protection rating?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2, with IP67 compared to the NB-1's IP65.

questions.question: Which robot is faster, and by how much?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 is faster: 30 km/h versus 24 km/h for the NB-1, a difference of 6 km/h.

questions.question: How do the operating temperature ranges of the two models compare?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1 operates from −10 °C to 45 °C, while the NB-2 operates from −20 °C to 50 °C.

questions.question: Which robot requires more frequent scheduled maintenance?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-1, with service every 500 operating hours (or 2,000 km) versus the NB-2's 800 operating hours.

questions.question: Which model has the longer warranty?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 has a 3-year warranty versus 2 years for the NB-1.

questions.question: What is the difference in monthly subscription cost between the NB-2 and the NB-1?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 costs $330 more per month ($780 vs $450).

questions.question: Which robot has the lower remote intervention rate?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2, at 3.1 per 1,000 km versus 4.2 for the NB-1.

questions.question: Which robot is better suited for cold climates?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2: it is rated to −20 °C (vs −10 °C for the NB-1) and can operate in light snow, while the NB-1 is suspended in snow.

questions.question: What is the difference in list price between the NB-2 and the NB-1?
A customer needs a robot that can operate in snow and carry 40 kg of payload. Which Nimbus model fits?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 Hauler: it has a 60 kg payload capacity and can operate in light snow, whereas the NB-1 is limited to 25 kg and is suspended in snow.

questions.question: What is the total first-year cost (hardware plus subscription) for 10 NB-2 Haulers?
questions.expected_answer: $413,600: 10 x $32,000 = $320,000 hardware plus 10 x $780 x 12 = $93,600 in subscriptions.

questions.question: A customer's city regularly reaches -15 C in winter. Which Nimbus model can be deployed there?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 Hauler, since the NB-1's minimum operating temperature is −10 °C.

questions.question: What speed limit applies inside geofenced zones, and what happens if a robot crosses the boundary?
questions.expected_answer: The default speed limit is 24 km/h; if a robot crosses the boundary it halts with error E317 and requires operator approval to resume.

questions.question: What is the total cost of 100 NB-1s: hardware (with volume discount), a 24-month subscription, and deployment fees for 4 sites?
Which model has the longer warranty, and what is the total subscription cost difference over that warranty period?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2 has the longer warranty (3 years); the subscription difference over 36 months is $330 x 36 = $11,880.

questions.question: A Level 3 incident occurs. What is the reporting deadline, and how can customers reach support for critical issues?
questions.expected_answer: Report within 1 hour and notify the regional manager; customers can reach support 24/7 at support@nimbusrobotics.com.

questions.question: Compared to the NB-1, how much longer is the NB-2's maintenance interval, and how many more deliveries per day can it handle?
questions.expected_answer: The NB-2's interval is 300 hours longer (800 vs 500 hours), and it handles 14 more deliveries per day (52 vs 38).

questions.question: A customer orders 300 NB-2 Haulers in a single order. What is the total hardware cost after the volume discount?
How quickly does the e-stop cut drive power, and how far does the robot brake from 24 km/h?
